heroHeadline: Trump Claims Khamenei Directly Involved in Nuclear Talks — Highest-Level Diplomatic Signal Yet as Mid-June Deadline Looms
heroSubtitle: From Cyrus the Great's Achaemenid Empire (550 BCE) through the 1979 Islamic Revolution to the post-war Islamic Republic — now at its most critical juncture: Trump publicly stated June 3 that Supreme Leader Khamenei is personally involved in US-Iran nuclear negotiations, escalating diplomatic signaling beyond Rubio/Pezeshkian-level talks. Both sides face a mid-June deadline as the April 8 ceasefire's 60-day extension approaches expiry and the MOU remains unsigned.
